summary: A broad set of updates improves scrolling and gestures: trackpad panning and axis locking behave more consistently, and touchscreen swipe-to-navigate respects page rules such as `touch-action` and `overscroll-behavior`. The work also strengthens graphics and video coordination across platforms, including Wayland surface handling and Android hardware-buffer synchronization. Separately, WebRender can draw more SVG shapes and clips directly, improving rendering coverage and reducing reliance on fallback paths.
